summary: test_memo_ctrl_s_sets_the_memo_without_submitting drives the real MemoTextArea/MemoScreen ctrl+s path (only the REST client is faked) and asserts create_task's memo='fix'/initial_prompt=None; production code only passes initial_prompt when submit=True (Enter), and the real client only puts initial_prompt in the POST body when non-None, so a violation delivering the memo as initial_prompt would flip index 3 from None to 'fix' and fail the test.
